Cc: Moni ca Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Avenzo exec workshop — draft agenda, potential dates, and calendar holds

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, we want to lock in an in-person workshop in Warsaw for the Avenzo executive + product leadership group. Tentative goals: align on integration milestones, run a joint ops tabletop, and executive Q&A.

Proposed windows (all local Warsaw time):
- Option A: Tue-Wed, Jul 21–22 (preferred by our EMEA team)
- Option B: Mon-Tue, Aug 3–4 (fallback if you need more lead time)

Ask from your side:
- Confirm the attendee list and titles (helpful for name badges/clearances).
- Tell us if any attendees need visa invitation letters, and the exact spelling of their passport name.
- Any local AV/network constraints we should know (wired VLAN, conference Zoom backchannel, projector resolution).

I attached a first-pass agenda and a proposed itinerary. We can place provisional calendar holds for the full-day workshop and optional pre-call the afternoon before.

Attachments: [Attachment: draft-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF)]

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min sync if that helps finalize choices.

Best,
Karthik

Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — good to see the draft. We prefer Option B (Aug 3–4); gives our legal team time to finish the MSA redlines and a couple of execs need travel approvals.

Attendees (provisionally):
- Dr. Lydia Chen (CEO) — passport name: Lydia Mei Chen
- Tomasz Kowalczyk (CPO) — passport name: Tomasz Kowalczyk
- Marta Nowak (Head of Integrations) — passport name: Marta Nowak
- plus two product leads (TBD)

Visa invitation: Lydia and Tomasz will need formal invitation letters for Poland. Can the invitation specify the company-hosted meeting and include our passport names, passport numbers, and expected dates? I can provide numbers to travel@avenzo.com — or you can send the template and we will fill it.

AV/network: The venue has wired internet but IT restricts external VPNs; if you plan to demo cloud-hosted inference endpoints, we may need to setup a temporary subnet or run a local containerized demo. I will loop Tomasz and travel for logistics.

Thanks — we will confirm the two product leads early next week.

Best,
Lydia

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Avenzo exec workshop — draft agenda, potential dates, and calendar holds

Lydia —

Thanks for the quick turn. Option B (Aug 3–4) works on our side — locking that now. Monica (CC’d) runs Travel & Events; Marissa covers on-site ops/AV. Monica — can you: 1) draft the visa invitation letter template and share it as a Word doc (we’ll ask Avenzo to populate passport numbers), 2) propose a travel itinerary for our team (we expect 3 people: myself, a Solutions Engineer, and one delivery lead) with economy-flex fares and arrival the afternoon of Aug 2, departure Aug 5.

Marissa — regarding the AV restriction, we can: a) prep an offline demo VM and bring a local router to isolate traffic, or b) request a temporary subnet from their IT team. Which is lower friction for us? Also attaching the site-map/AV checklist so you can flag gaps.

I’ll place provisional calendar holds for Aug 2 (pre-call, 2pm CEST) and Aug 3–4 (full days).

K

Attachments: [Attachment: site-map-and-av-requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]
